summary: The diff adds a single-page React marketing site with TopNav smooth-scrolling, Hero/About/Services/Projects/Contact sections, construction-themed styling tokens, and basic SEO meta/title. However, the required generated image assets are only referenced in code and are not shown as added under the specified public assets path. The diff also introduces Internet Identity/auth-related hooks, React Query actor plumbing, an empty backend actor, and a Caffeine.ai attribution footer link that were not requested for a static marketing site.

missing_requirements.requirement: Add static asset handling for the required generated images by placing them under frontend/public/assets/generated and rendering them in the hero, logo/brand area, and projects gallery.
missing_requirements.reason: Components reference the required image paths, but the diff does not show any image files added under frontend/public/assets/generated (only code files were added). Therefore the requirement that the images exist under that directory is not evidenced by the diff.

hallucinated_features.description: Internet Identity authentication context/provider and related identity management logic included in the app bootstrap.
hallucinated_features.reason: The BuildRequest explicitly says authentication is not required for this marketing site; nevertheless, Internet Identity hooks/provider are added and used.

hallucinated_features.description: Backend actor integration hook using React Query and actor creation logic.
hallucinated_features.reason: No backend functionality or actor usage was requested for a static marketing site; the diff adds actor hooks and query invalidation/refetch logic.

hallucinated_features.description: Caffeine.ai promotional/attribution link in the footer with UTM tracking parameters.
hallucinated_features.reason: Footer attribution/promotional outbound link was not requested in the BuildRequest requirements or acceptance criteria.

hallucinated_features.description: Addition of an empty Motoko backend canister actor.
hallucinated_features.reason: The BuildRequest did not ask to add backend code for this marketing website; an empty actor file is added without specified purpose.
